title: Removing from service.
officialText: Safety net systems, guardrail systems, and alternative systems authorized under Section 3308.8 showing signs of mildew, corrosion, wear, tears, breaks, frays, damage, or deterioration that may substantially affect the strength of such shall be immediately removed from service.
